# Mini World Bosses

## Post 6343 by Dragunovi (Turtle WoW Team) [STAFF] — 2020-06-13T18:56:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6343#p6343 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

**Well, i guess it is time once more.** The promise is simple. They will be designed for 5-10 player parties, their complexity will increase the higher level the zone is. **Example:** ***Skyterror*** (Mini-boss for Westfall) could have a rip bleed effect and an AoE fear and that would be it. I imagine higher level mini-world bosses having around 3-4 abilities like dungeon bosses. They will have 3-4 unique ***Bind on Pickup*** drops, so you would know the ones that have their gear truly earned it themselves and didn't just buy it from the Auction House. They will have %40-60 faster speeds to avoid kiting and being soloed that way. They will have around 48-72 hour respawn timer. Well that's it. *Mini World Bosses, coming* ***Soon(TM)***.
 **PS**: Reserving spots for the mini-bosses ahead of time.

*Last edited by Dragunovi on Mon Jun 15, 2020 12:20 am, edited 2 times in total.*

## Post 6344 by Dragunovi (Turtle WoW Team) [STAFF] — 2020-06-13T18:57:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6344#p6344 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

**10-20 Level Mini-Bosses**

 **Reminder:** Even if they look easy, they're stronger than normal dungeon bosses, so don't try them on your own!
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/npccreato ... AsMTYsIiJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (***Skyterror*** **<Shadow of Westfall>**, **the Mini-Boss of Westfall**) He can be found at the southeastern parts of Westfall, at the edge of the lake. Pretty basic fight, he mainly uses a **Bleed attack** and an **AoE Fear** that fears for 4 seconds. That's basically it. Drops are:
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Terrornail**, one of Skyterror's nails, big enough to be used as a dagger, with good stats.)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Cape of the Sky Shadow**, a cool name for an item that drops from a pesky bird. Strenght and a bit of spirit, it should be useful.)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Feathered Gloves**, a pair of gloves with agility, intellect and stamina, perfect for a druid or a shaman, if they can get here!)

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/npccreato ... AsMTYsIiJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (***Shardspear* <The Impaler>**, **the First Mini-Boss of The Barrens**) He can be found at the Forgotten Pools, trailing around the pool. His abilities are **Impale (Ticks for 20 Damage)** that he uses if you're away from him and **Net to root you for 10 seconds**, especially dangerous if your tank loses aggro.
His Drops are:
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Rockshard Spear**, a good spear for any melee class, also a good stat stick for hunters.)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wiTlVMTCJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Centaur Ceremonial Robe**, just a good robe for casters.)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Kodohunter's Ring**, a ring with agility and intellect, useful for almost all classes.)

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/npccreato ... IwLCIiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (***The Loch Monster* <Ancient Thrasher>, The Mini Boss of Loch Modan**) It can be found in the depths of the Loch. It has a **Bleed** and a **Poison** attack, keep the tank topped off!) Drops are:
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wiTlVMTCJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Glowing Thresher Belt**)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Sword of the Loch**, guess **The Loch Monster** ate the Lady of the Lake.)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Bracers of Flowing Thoughts**)

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/npccreato ... wxNiwiIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (***Wulfrak* <The First Son of Arugal>, The Mini-Boss of Silverpine Forest**) It can be found at the very south of the forest, near the walls of **Gilneas**. He can bite you with an **Infected Bite** to increase your damage taken and give you the **Gift of Arugal** for heavy damage every minute. His drops are:
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Wildcaster Boots**)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Howling Shoulders**, a pair of good shoulders at an early level.)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wiTlVMTCJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Wolfguard Chain**)

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/npccreato ... E2LCIiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (***Farrakis* <The Stormscale Captain>, The Mini-Boss of Darkshore**) He can be found at the very north of the zone, it's pretty empty there. He uses **Demoralizing Shout** to decrease Melee Attack Power and **Hamstring** to slow you (They're already super fast but why not?). His drops are:
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Robe of Wild Magic**, an early robe with some spell power for Frost and Arcane spells, good for mages.)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Wavecrasher**, a polearm that can proc Frost Blasts for extra damage, ***it doesn't slow your target.***)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Myrimidon's Gauntlets**, a good pair of mail gloves.)

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/npccreato ... E2LCIiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Skarrgl <Agamaggan's Wrath>, The Second Mini Boss of the Barrens**) He can be found to the north of **Camp Taurajo**. Because the Barrens is a pretty big zone (and people wanted it) it'll has a second **Mini World Boss**. This boss is higher level (**Level 25**) and harder than the others as the Barrens' level zone is pretty large. It can **Sunder Armor** your tank and do a weak **Mortal Strike** (%130 of weapon damage and %50 less healing for 5 seconds). His drops are:
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Quilguard Boots**)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Warded Boarleather Belt**, not a lot of stats but its extra armor and resistances are really fitting for **Bear Druids**.)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (**Briarthorn Ring**, casters don't get a good ring at this level range so i thought i'd add one for them.)
